data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 was GBP 792.7m. Analysis of the gross claims development shows a small favourable prior-year movement (release) of GBP 10.6m (approximately 1.3% of opening reserves), driven by favourable claims development particularly in longer-tail and specialty classes. No material quantified gross adverse prior-year strengthening was identified. The Group notes external RITC adjustments during the year which materially affected gross balances but the underlying prior-year (<=2021) development is a modest release.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities) 2022 comparative column. Prior-year development (GBP -10.6m) computed from the gross claims development table (triangle) by comparing the 'current estimate' to the previous diagonal for underwriting years <= 2021; no explicit gross 'movement in prior year provision' line was provided. An External RITC movement (gross -216.5m) is reported in the technical provisions note and affects comparatives; triangle-derived PYD excludes 2022 and 2023 per methodology. Exact reserve narrative sentence sourced from Chairman's Statement. Some event years (e.g. 'Ukraine') are referenced in narrative and may span 2021-2022 exposures; amounts for named events are not quantified in the report.
